Obtaining and installing patches

A CA-2002-31 patch has been issued for BIG-IP and 3-DNS version 4.5.

To download and install the patch:

Open the F5 Networks Downloads page in a browser.
Navigate to the BIG-IP >> BIG-IP v4.x >> 4.5 section.
Click CA-2002-31 and accept the End User Software license.
Download the bind-8.3.4-1-BSD_OS-4.1.im file to the /var/tmp directory.
Once the download is complete, type the following command to install the patch.


im bind-8.3.4-1-BSD_OS-4.1.im
To restart the name server, type the following command:


ndc restart
To verify that the upgrade has been properly installed, type the following command:


named -v


You should see server version 8.3.4. If you do not see this version number, contact F5 Networks Technical Support for assistance.
